request_text: Run the lock-interop spike (first WP of #6193): prove Python/Java mutual exclusion of the kernel.locks event-log lock (fcntl.flock / msvcrt.locking vs Java FileChannel.lock) on Linux, macOS and Windows, and byte-identical interleaved O_APPEND appends readable by both the Python reader and the Java event-log reader; CI matrix evidence and a GO/NO-GO spike report under docs/.
